companyProjects.title: SPOREDA - Sports, Recreation & Community Management Platform
companyProjects.shortDescription: A full-stack platform for managing sports programmes, events, blogs, registrations, CMS content, and administration with secure authentication, role-based access, analytics, and a scalable REST API architecture.
companyProjects.fullDescription: SPOREDA is a comprehensive sports and recreation management platform designed to help organizations manage programmes, events, blogs, testimonials, CMS content, and participant registrations from a centralized admin panel. The platform includes secure JWT authentication with refresh tokens, role-based access control, reusable REST APIs, dashboard analytics, media management, and a scalable backend architecture built using Node.js, Express.js, Sequelize, and MySQL. The project focuses on maintainability, modular architecture, security, and providing administrators with complete control over website content and community activities.
features: Built a secure authentication system with JWT Access Tokens, Refresh Tokens, Auto Logout, Role-Based Authorization, Profile Management, Password Reset, and Protected APIs.
Developed a reusable Category Management module supporting multiple modules (Blog & Events) with dynamic category assignment.
Built a complete Blog/Insights CMS including CRUD operations, SEO-friendly slugs, rich text content, featured blogs, image uploads, ordering, and status management.
Developed a full Event Management module with registrations, participant limits, registration deadlines, event scheduling, organizers, locations, featured events, and registration tracking.
Implemented an Event Registration system with unique registration numbers, participant management, registration statuses, and event-wise registration analytics.
Designed a Dashboard API providing summary statistics, upcoming events, registration trends, event performance analytics, recent registrations, and quick statistics for the admin panel.
Built reusable media upload APIs with centralized Multer configuration, validation, automatic cleanup on errors, and support for images, videos, and PDF documents.
challenges: Designed a scalable modular backend architecture where every feature follows a consistent structure (Model → Validation → Service → Controller → Routes), making future modules easy to develop and maintain.

Implemented secure authentication using JWT Access Tokens, Refresh Tokens, middleware protection, automatic session handling, and inactivity-based logout while maintaining a clean authentication flow.

Developed efficient dashboard analytics by combining multiple modules, registration statistics, event performance, and summary reports into a single optimized API without compromising readability or maintainability.
responsibilities: Led the overall backend architecture and API development for the SPOREDA platform.
Designed the complete MySQL database schema, Sequelize models, relationships, validations, and REST API structure.
Implemented secure authentication, authorization, refresh token management, protected routes, and user session handling.
Developed major backend modules including Authentication, Categories, Blogs, Events, Event Registrations, Dashboard Analytics, CMS, and Media Upload Management.
Contributed to frontend development by integrating APIs, implementing dynamic pages, improving UI functionality, and collaborating with the frontend team.
Reviewed project architecture, solved complex backend issues, optimized APIs, and guided development to ensure scalability, maintainability, and production-ready code quality.

personalProjects.title: Interactive Developer Portfolio
personalProjects.shortDescription: A cinematic, highly interactive personal portfolio built with React, Tailwind CSS, and advanced animation libraries.
personalProjects.fullDescription: An immersive, senior-designer level personal portfolio web application designed to showcase professional experience, featured projects, and technical skills. Built with a focus on modern web design principles, featuring complex scroll-triggered animations using GSAP and Framer Motion, glassmorphism UI elements, seamless page transitions, and responsive parallax layouts.
features: Scroll-triggered cinematic animations using GSAP and Framer Motion
Dynamic experience calculator and JSON-driven content architecture
Fully responsive split-screen layouts and custom UI components
Custom SVG noise textures and interactive mouse parallax effects
Performance optimized with Vite and Tailwind
challenges: Designing complex cross-browser compatible scroll animations that feel natural and performant.
Managing state and refs across multiple nested framer-motion components for seamless transitions.
Balancing heavy visual aesthetics (blurs, gradients, particles) with smooth 60fps rendering performance.
responsibilities: Designed the complete UI/UX with a focus on a premium, dark-mode aesthetic.
Implemented all frontend code, animations, and data-driven component structures.
Optimized asset loading and rendering performance for smooth scroll experiences.
